humanUi.mode: deterministic conversational assistant with intent/entity query planning
humanUi.localStorage: optional and disposable; stores username, latest normalized player snapshot (public or user-entered) and recent questions when available
humanUi.interimPlayerLoader: official public profile HTML; skill level/XP only when browser cross-origin policy permits
humanUi.manualSkills: Optional username; enter known whole-number levels; blanks and XP stay unknown. Clearly labelled user-entered, not verified.
humanUi.refreshFailure: Retain previous same-player snapshot with warning and timestamp; never reuse across different usernames; ignore superseded responses.
humanUi.visualStyle: FlatMMO-inspired charcoal panels, brown secondary controls, green primary actions, cream text and monospace headings; no external images/fonts required.
humanUi.manualFormLayout: Bounded dialog with independently scrolling fields and persistent Save/Cancel footer; two skill columns at phone widths.
humanUi.queryEngine: v1.7.1 browser-side natural-language interpreter: intent detection, whole-word/phrase entity resolution, short follow-up context including alternative-source follow-ups, structured query planning, multi-source acquisition lookup and conversational composition; no LLM required
humanUi.conversationContext: Tracks the recent resolved subject/intent in memory for short follow-ups such as it/there/requirements and elliptical alternatives such as other-than-combat; disposable with the session
humanUi.inlineLevels: Skill levels explicitly stated in a question may be used for that answer only; they do not overwrite the saved/manual player snapshot
humanUi.acquisitionIndex: Combines item-specific world/resource nodes, crafting/production recipes, quest rewards, explicit item-named NPC shops/trades/services and monster drops. Generic shop descriptions remain service/location evidence and are not treated as complete inventories.

coverage.armourResourceCosts: deep-normalized for smithable melee, craftable archery, and enchantable mage armour
coverage.questProcedures: 19 normalized core quest records; 2 additional observation-backed quest placeholders have incomplete procedures/rewards
coverage.beds: first-class index for explicitly documented bed locations
coverage.internalRooms: detailed for 13/14 areas; Desert currently partial
coverage.entityGraph: quest steps <-> rooms/NPCs/monsters; monsters <-> rooms; rooms <-> resource nodes
coverage.monsterRoomLinks: 52/82 monster records linked to 82 exact room/access references
coverage.questRoomLinks: 55/104 quest steps have one or more exact room IDs; all 104 carry structured area/room link state
coverage.bedSemantics: bedStatus distinguishes documented beds from rooms where a bed is merely not documented
coverage.mechanicsRules: 12 explicit rules/readiness records including observed Sleep/Run behavior and calculation blocks
coverage.aiContext: schema 1.6; merges 2 observed quest placeholders and embeds mechanics rules plus player-source and refresh policies
coverage.playerAwareness: Skill-level checks from public profiles or explicitly labelled manual levels. Inventory, bank, equipment and quest completion remain unknown.

safeNow: recipe material totals already represented in structured equipment data
pendingUserObservation: Sleep Point costs and zero-Sleep behaviour by activity type
pendingPlayerApi: other player snapshot fields exposed by the official API

knownIssues: Desert internal-room coverage remains partial; Desert quest steps are intentionally mostly area-only.
30 monster records have no exact room link.
Some bootstrap monster area labels conflict with current room-page evidence; both are retained rather than silently overwritten.
Room adjacency remains incomplete where the wiki does not explicitly state a route.
Monster bootstrap mirror still awaits official refresh.
Feeding The Homeless and Atlas Crown are now named observation-backed records, but their full procedures/rewards remain incomplete.
The interim public-profile loader can be blocked by browser cross-origin policy; official player API integration is pending.
Exact combat hit/damage formulas remain unresolved, so exact DPS, kill time, survivability and recommended combat levels are intentionally blocked.
Agility level 1-19 Run-step progression and exact zero-Sleep behavior by activity remain pending observations.
Known source conflicts remain retained in verification notes.
The v1.7.1 natural-language interpreter is deterministic and finite; unusual or genuinely ambiguous phrasing may still require a more specific question.
updatePolicy: Manually maintained static snapshot. The deployment workflow publishes committed files; it does not refresh game data or player snapshots. AI retrieval is optional/best-effort.
